name: ultrareview
description: Deep multi-agent code review for Codex: independent finders, a fresh verifier per finding, reproduction in a disposable copy, a gap sweep, an independent adjudicator and an evidence gate.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent code review with independent verification
interface.longDescription: Run $ultrareview in a repository: ten finder angles, a fresh verifier per candidate (CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE / REFUTED), reproduction of confirmed defects against the real code in a disposable copy, a sweep for what the first pass missed, an independent adjudicator and a deterministic gate that checks every quote and every claimed command.
